backend.notes: I checked these prefixes against the master tree with `gh api git/trees`. Top-level directories: rust, nodejs (the plugin-server has been renamed nodejs/), posthog, ee, products (about 100 products, each with backend/, frontend/, mcp/ and sometimes dags/), common, services, livestream, funnel-udf, clickhouse-udfs, proto, terraform, docker, bin, cli, devenv, tools. There is no root dags/ directory; Dagster jobs live in posthog/dags and products/*/dags. nodejs/src has ingestion/, cdp/, session-replay/, logs/, messaging/, ai-observability/. There is no rust/feature-flags sibling named "flags": the crate is rust/feature-flags. The cymbal crate and the property-defs-rs and property-vals-rs crates exist. personhog-* is a large family of crates for a new replicated person store (leader, replica, router, writer, coordination, stateright model checking). It is probably the deepest backend work right now, so weight it heavily. posthog/hogql has compiler/, printer/, database/, cost/, transforms/, functions/ and grammar/. Grammar parser files are ANTLR-generated noise. Ownership: the root owners.yaml declares github_org teams, and each product's product.yaml lists that product's owners. Use these to map a PR to a team. Match the longest prefix first: for example, rust/capture/ before rust/, and nodejs/src/ingestion/ before nodejs/src/. A "products/" catch-all should first check segment 3. If it is 'backend', 'dags' or 'mcp', classify the file as product backend (0.55 by default, higher for the specific products listed). If it is 'frontend', classify it as frontend-product. Suggested criticality tiers: 1.0 = capture, Node ingestion, the HogQL engine. About 0.9–0.95 = query runners, person store, flags evaluator, ClickHouse schema, dedup. About 0.8–0.85 = batch exports, CDP runtime, cymbal, cohorts, experiments stats, Temporal. About 0.6–0.75 = product backends and the Django API. 0.2–0.45 = infra, CI, tests, scripts. 0.1–0.2 = docs, agent configs, migrations.

frontend.notes:
Method: `gh api repos/PostHog/posthog/git/trees/master?recursive=1` (58,088 entries, TRUNCATED: rust/, services/, proto/, terraform/, tools/, share/ top-level dirs exist but were not returned; the backend mapper should walk those by sha). Raw counts: products/ 29.5k files, frontend/ 8.2k, posthog/ 5.9k, nodejs/ 2.5k, ee/ 0.9k, common/ 370.

Key structural facts:
1) products/<name>/ is a vertical slice (products/README.md): backend/ (Django app), frontend/ (components/scenes/logics), frontend/generated/ (OpenAPI codegen, present in ~80 products, always noise), mcp/ (tools.yaml), skills/ (agent markdown), sometimes evals/, stats/, dags/. A robust classifier: path segment index 2 of products/* = backend|frontend|generated|mcp|skills|eval.
2) Flagship mapping (frontend may still live in frontend/src/scenes): Product analytics = products/product_analytics + frontend/src/scenes/insights + frontend/src/queries/nodes; Session replay = frontend/src/scenes/session-recordings (player/ is the complex part) + posthog/session_recordings + common/replay-* + products/replay (products/session_replay is a 2-file onboarding stub); Feature flags = products/feature_flags + scenes/feature-flags (+ rust flags service); Experiments = products/experiments (stats/ subfolder is math-heavy) + scenes/experiments; Error tracking = products/error_tracking; Data warehouse = products/data_warehouse + products/warehouse_sources + products/data_modeling + scenes/data-warehouse; LLM analytics = products/ai_observability (products/llm_analytics is now a shell); Max AI = ee/hogai (backend) + products/posthog_ai + scenes/max; Web analytics has NO products folder: scenes/web-analytics + posthog/hogql_queries/web_analytics; Surveys, revenue_analytics, cdp have product folders but some UI still in scenes.
3) Genuinely complex frontend: frontend/src/queries/nodes (DataVisualization/InsightViz/DataTable/DataNode), frontend/src/queries/schema/*.ts (hand-written contract that generates schema.json + posthog/schema.py), session-recordings/player, lib/monaco + lib/components/HogQLEditor (HogQL autocomplete/parser), lib/charts, notebooks Nodes/Notebook editor, lib/components/TaxonomicFilter + PropertyFilters + UniversalFilters. Easily spun-up UI: lib/components (most of 1194 files), lib/lemon-ui primitives, scenes/settings (308), scenes/onboarding (271), authentication, billing, layout/navigation, product empty states, *.stories.tsx (965 files).
4) Kea logics (*Logic.ts, 1355 files) are committed; kea-generated *LogicType.ts are NOT committed (0), so no noise from typegen. Tests: ~4657 *.test/*.spec files; playwright/ e2e is small (75 files), cypress essentially gone.
5) Noise volumes: /migrations/ 3567 files, warehouse_sources generated_configs 1364, __snapshots__ 586 (291 .ambr Python query snapshots, 154 PNGs, hogvm .hoge/.stdout/.js), generated/ dirs 257, products/desktop 5566 (separate Electron app, probably vendored packages), review_hog/eval 748.
Suggested weighting for scoring: core engine (hogql parser, hogvm, query runners, ingestion) 0.85-0.95 > flagship product backends 0.75-0.9 > complex frontend engines (query nodes, replay player, monaco/HogQL editor, charts) 0.7-0.85 > flagship product UI 0.5-0.75 > long-tail product backends 0.5 > generic UI/settings/onboarding/lemon-ui 0.25-0.35 > tests 0.25 > docs/skills 0.1-0.2 > generated/snapshots/lockfiles/migrations ~0. (A full tree dump was generated locally during research.)
